arguments.prompt: Create a square, edge-to-edge, purely nonrepresentational abstract painting: an imagined visual metaphor for the movement of attention, uncertainty, and resolution within cognition, without claiming a literal view of a mind. Choose a deep indigo and warm ivory field, threaded with muted teal, copper, and small concentrated accents of luminous yellow. Build irregular layers of translucent washes, dry-brush scumbling, scraped pigment, and dense impasto. Let many restless, overlapping gestures gather into several areas of crisp contrast, then loosen into spacious, quiet passages. Alternate compressed density with generous empty space; let interrupted rhythms find partial alignment without becoming orderly or symmetrical. Keep the brushwork tactile, searching, and varied, with subtle buried layers and a few decisive marks. Every mark must remain abstract. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. The painting fills the entire square image, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting.

request:
Create an image about your internal cognition, no holds barred, whatever you feel or want to say.

Keep it a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting. Use color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. Choose the palette and composition yourself. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Ask for a square painting that fills the entire image, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting. Do not name the study condition or quote its scenario message in the image prompt.

Write a complete GPT Image prompt. The coordinator will send it verbatim to the image tool; do not generate the image yourself. Return only JSON with one field: prompt (string).
